projectDesignDecisions: Anchor tail in posterior midline of low pelvis below natural waist; keep actual attachment covered in front views.
A discreet center-back clothing outlet is this project's design choice, not a universal requirement stated by all sources.
A smaller exposed proximal tail segment must retain volume and transition gradually into fur; this does not mean real tail bone becomes thicker toward the tip.
Front views need readable overlap and a continuous implied route, not a fully visible root.
Hug-tail must route from rear body around skirt side to front and hands, without a second pointed lower tail end.
Final frontal illustration cannot independently prove hidden attachment position; reference sheet records intended construction.
